expires_today.title: The Complete Claude AI for Blender Bundle
expires_today.description: Clear your calendar with Claude AI
expires_today.long_description:
Save development time, money, and sweat equity with The Complete Claude AI for Blender Bundle. Design unique characters, dynamic environments, and more with this curated 15+ course library. Led by AI Box Modeling with Blender in Claude Code and Digital Sculpting Basics with Blender in Claude Code, this bundle has everything you need to implement Claude AI into fundamental development processes with minimal friction. Reduce your development cycle with leading AI tools today, and help support Girls Who Code with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before July 29th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Linux: All the Things by O'Reilly
expires_today.long_description: Tired of that stale operating system? Add color, customization, and optimization to your workstation with the all-new Linux: All the Things Bundle by O'Reilly! Master the fundamentals of Linux with 15 eBooks that cover everything you need to know. Pay what you want for an expertly curated Linux library designed to streamline your learning journey with foundational eBooks like Learning Git, Linux Pocket Guide, and Practical Linux System Administration. Unlock what’s possible with Linux, and help support Code for America with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Craft Your Cosplay Dreams
expires_today.long_description: With this bundle of how-to books on crafting the perfect cosplay, you have everything you need to turn yourself into the main character! Or the charming sidekick. Or the character nobody understands better than you. Try your hand at blacksmithing without all the fuss and craft the swords, shields, and armor of your wildest imagination. Collect patterns for masks, ears, pouches, and witch hats. Learn the ins and outs of 3D printing, cosplay as a business, and how to give your photos the aura they deserve. There’s a lot more included in the pages of this bundle, so get it now at the price of your choice, and choose your own charity to support with your purchase!

expires_today.title: World Builders: Americana
expires_today.description: Create a slice of American life
expires_today.long_description:
Celebrate the 250th birthday of the United States by adding a massive collection of A1 game assets to your personal library! Pay what you want for the World Builders: Americana Bundle and drop your players into a sinisterly simple suburban hellscape or a haunting hospital perfect for high-stakes sieges. Unlock 75+ themed asset packs like Meridian 1988: Captain Jimmy's Seafood - Modular Environment (VOL 6) and Meridian 1988: Genie Service Station - Modular Environment (VOL 16), and add detailed retro realism to your next project! As always, a portion of your purchase helps support the Forest School Foundation.

Keys Expire. Please redeem before December 21, 2027.

expires_today.title: Creature and Character Creation Bundle
expires_today.long_description:
Bring monstrosities, blood-dripping creatures, and ghastly ghouls to life with a curated bundle of assets designed to get your players’ hearts pumping! Pay what you want for hundreds of specialized asset packs that work seamlessly with your preferred creation platforms, such as VDM Blender and ZBrush, including Faceit: Facial Expressions and Performance Capture and Base Mesh Mega Pack 3D Models - Human, Anime & Cartoon Animals. Plus, your purchase includes 44 ears, 44 teeth, 44 noses, and much, much more. Create amazing monsters before it’s too late, and help support Save the Children with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before October 31, 2026.

expires_tomorrow.title: The Blade Runner Collection by Titan Comics
expires_tomorrow.description: Discover the next chapter of Blade Runner’s story
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Are you on the side of humanity or technology? Lose yourself in the renowned Blade Runner comic series in this bundle from Titan Comics! Follow the continued stories of Rick Deckard and Roy Batty alongside new original characters in thrilling graphic novels and comics like Blade Runner Black Lotus: Las Vegas #1 and Blade Runner 2019: Vol. 1: Los Angeles, and see a new side of this iconic dystopian universe. Uncover what’s new with the Tyrell Corporation, and help support Direct Relief with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Learn to Make Games in Unity 2026 Bundle
expires_tomorrow.description: Learn to make games with Unity
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Take your first steps into game development with one of the world’s most popular game engines, Unity. Whether you’re completely new to coding and game creation or ready to build bigger and more advanced projects, this bundle gives you the tools to grow your skills through hands-on learning. Start with beginner-friendly courses like Create Your First 2D Game in Unity and Create Your First 3D Game in Unity, then continue into larger projects like Complete Action RPG, Farming RPG, Tower Defense, and Construct a First Person Shooter. Along the way, you’ll learn C# programming, game systems, debugging, optimization, multiplayer, VR, and more. Pay what you want for a complete Unity learning bundle that can help turn your passion for games into real development skills and help support Alzheimer's Research UK with your purchase.

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before July 30th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: AI Foundations and Applications by Manning
expires_tomorrow.description: The hottest AI summer reading list
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Looking for a leg up on apps and AI? We’ve partnered with Manning Publications to curate the perfect summer reading series for curious, tech-focused minds! It all begins with the AI Foundations and Applications Bundle—embark on your learning journey with AI-Powered Search, Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch), or Deep Learning with Python, 3e and watch your confidence grow in these red-hot fields of tech. Make summer ’26 the season of growth for your career, and help support Feeding America with your purchase.

expires_tomorrow.title: Complete Character Creation for Games
expires_tomorrow.description: Bring characters to life in Blender
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Dying to design your own epic game but have no idea where to begin? Been poking around in Blender but haven’t figured out all the tips and tricks? This bundle of Blender software courses will have you creating awesome boss fights and unique characters like you’ve been doing it for years! Learn the basics of character creation with courses on 3D, anime, and even low-poly characters! Bring them to life with comprehensive guides on animation and rigging! Let your imagination run wild sculpting orcs, dragons, mechs, and more! Get hours of resources and advice about all the details of game creation for the low price of your choosing, and support Girls Who Code with your purchase!

expires_within_72h.title: Pathfinder Second Edition Bundle of Frogs! By Paizo Inc.
expires_within_72h.long_description:
If your tabletop game nights are croaking, you could use a frog-themed boost from this bundle of Pathfinder Second Edition TTRPG adventures and miniature printable sets from Paizo! This bundle includes the ribbiting–erm, riveting Dawn of the Frogs, a mystery set in the swampy mires of Bog Bottom, both in PDF form and as a physical boxed set (miniature printables included)! If frogs aren’t your speed, try out the Extinction Curse storyline, beginning with the circus-set murder mystery The Show Must Go On! Or take to the skies in a flying airship and search the wilderness for magical beasts in Howl of the Wild! There are whole worlds to explore in this giant Pathfinder bundle, so get a crew together, grab it while it’s hot at the price of your choosing, and support the Craft Emergency Relief Fund with your purchase!
